speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal — two agents on one repository, in their own worktrees
description: Short feature clip. A git worktree per task, made from the launcher in one click: the agent starts inside it, a second agent keeps working in the main checkout at the same time, and closing the cell asks before it discards anything. Slides are English in both language versions.

beats.text: Name a task and press once. MulmoTerminal cuts a git worktree for it and starts an agent inside.

html: Worktree
One click, one worktree.
<video src='./mt-worktree-assets/01-create.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:1200px;display:block'></video>

beats.text: Two agents, one repository, side by side. Neither one is standing on the other's files.

html: Worktree
Two agents, one repo.

beats.text: Close it and it asks first, naming what would be lost. Say remove, and the worktree and the cell go together.

html: Worktree
It asks before it removes.
<video src='./mt-worktree-assets/03-remove.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:1200px;display:block'></video>
